## Raw definition {#raw-definition}

```text
# Only active_vessel has control authority. Emergency stop is a separate flag.
uint8 STATE_PLAYER=0
uint8 STATE_PYLON=1
# Compatibility aliases.
uint8 STATE_UNOWNED=0
uint8 STATE_OWNED=1

std_msgs/Header header
uint8 state
# Observation guard: same bridge-local generation as VesselLifecycle.
uint64 generation
string vessel_id
string vessel_name

# Compatibility: last request source, never another owner.
string controller_id
string lease_id

# Compatibility: always zero; priorities do not arbitrate control.
int32 priority
float64 lease_remaining_sec
bool sas_suppressed
bool emergency_stop
uint64 last_sequence
string reason
```
